skills.name: lumi-style
skills.description: LUMI's design language and output writing style. Use when producing business documents, slides, client materials, marketing copy, HTML reports, or charts for LUMI — in any language — or when reviewing existing drafts against LUMI standards. Triggers: "LUMI style", "lumi-style", "按 LUMI 风格". Not for: pure coding tasks or content unrelated to LUMI deliverables.
